sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and  learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with 1 C.C. Case No.7 of 2025 pending in the Court of learned J.M.F.C. (Rural), Rourkela, for commission of offence punishable under Sections 405/406/420 of IPC.
3.

It is submitted by the learned counsel for the Petitioner that contractual obligation inter se between the parties being given the colour of criminality and on the basis of registration of FIR pursuant to the order passed by the learned Magistrate, the Petitioner is apprehending arrest.

4. It is also submitted that civil litigation at the instance of the informant is pending in Court of learned Civil Judge, Senior Division Rourkela in C.S. No.153 of 2023 wherein the present Petitioner has been arrayed as defendant No.1.
In such background, Petitioner may be protected by pre-arrest bail.
5. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for pre-arrest bail.

6. Taking into account the nature of allegation, this Court directs that in the event of arrest of the Petitioner in connection with the aforesaid case, he shall be released on bail by the Arresting Officer on such terms and conditions deemed just and proper with further conditions that he will cooperate with the investigation.
